title: Node3D created with script has different rotation proprierties than if it's created with tscn
body:
### Tested versions

- Found in Godot v4.6.2.stable

### System information

Godot v4.6.2.stable - Fedora Linux 43 (Workstation Edition) on Wayland - X11 display driver, Multi-window, 1 monitor - Vulkan (Forward+) - integrated Intel(R) Graphics (RPL-U) - Intel(R) Core(TM) 5 120U (12 threads) - 15.31 GiB memory

### Issue description

- Found in Godot 4.6.2
- I'm on Linux Fedora, GNOME Desktop

## Video:

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/4f09502d-b74f-40d4-aa14-e1feb105cf6f

## Example:
### Doesn't work as expected

`grass_tile_no_label.gd`
```py
extends Node3D

func _ready() -> void:
	var label: Label3D = Label3D.new()
	label.position.y = 0.1
	label.rotation.x = -90
	
	label.text = "Label created with script"
	
	self.add_child(label)
```

`grass_tile_no_label.tscn`
```
[gd_scene format=3 uid="uid://b6yp6ai4q2b8n"]

[ext_resource type="Script" uid="uid://btrt3k5n32oy4" path="res://scenes/bug/grass_tile_no_label.gd" id="1_p5p8p"]
[ext_resource type="PackedScene" path="res://scenes/tile_static_body.tscn" id="2_04xlv"]

[ext_resource type="PackedScene" uid="uid://bs72ogkvdd7d6" path="res://scenes/proto_controller/proto_controller.tscn" id="4_04xlv"]

[node name="GrassTileNoLabel" type="Node3D" unique_id=457582317]

[node name="GrassTile" type="Node3D" parent="." unique_id=1361234842]

[node name="TileStaticBody3D" parent="GrassTile" unique_id=826713353 instance=ExtResource("2_04xlv")]

[node name="grass" parent="GrassTile" unique_id=255999741 instance=ExtResource("3_l5bbn")]

[node name="ProtoController" parent="." unique_id=431487583 instance=ExtResource("4_04xlv")]
transform = Transform3D(1, 0, 0, 0, 1, 0, 0, 0, 1, 0, 0.40304983, 0)

```

---

### Works as expected
```
[gd_scene format=3 uid="uid://cbtac6l2wttar"]

[ext_resource type="PackedScene" uid="uid://cgt6sxhoqf1qv" path="res://scenes/grass_tile.tscn" id="1_o5qli"]
[ext_resource type="PackedScene" uid="uid://bs72ogkvdd7d6" path="res://scenes/proto_controller/proto_controller.tscn" id="2_0wfyh"]

[node name="Node3D" type="Node3D" unique_id=258896431]

[node name="GrassTile" parent="." unique_id=457582317 instance=ExtResource("1_o5qli")]
script = null

[node name="ProtoController" parent="." unique_id=431487583 instance=ExtResource("2_0wfyh")]
transform = Transform3D(1, 0, 0, 0, 1, 0, 0, 0, 1, 0, 0.5627234, 0)

[node name="Label3D" type="Label3D" parent="." unique_id=1086761295]
transform = Transform3D(1, 0, 0, 0, -4.371139e-08, 1, 0, -1, -4.371139e-08, 0, 0.1, 0)
text = "Label created with tscn"
```

### Steps to reproduce

Create and rotate a label with the script, as shown here: (other rotations give)

```sh
func _ready() -> void:
	var label: Label3D = Label3D.new()
	label.position.y = 0.1
	label.rotation.x = -90
	
	label.text = "Label created with script"
	
	self.add_child(label)
```
